questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: Why is data stored in Google Cloud kept secure and private?

options.text: Data is encrypted by the Security Command Center
Data is encrypted by Cloud Data Loss Prevention
Data is encrypted when an appropriate tag is applied

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud encrypts customer content at rest by default, with no action required from the customer. This default encryption protects stored data; Security Command Center and Cloud Data Loss Prevention are separate security services, and tags do not enable the baseline encryption. [Google Cloud default encryption at rest](https://cloud.google.com/docs/security/encryption/default-encryption)\
\
**Learn more:** [Google Cloud: Default encryption at rest](https://cloud.google.com/docs/security/encryption/default-encryption)

questions.question:
An organization wants to make sure its developers can readily use application programming interfaces (APIs) in future projects.  
  
Which Google product or solution should it use?
questions.explanation:
Apigee is Google Cloud’s API management platform for building, managing, securing, and exposing APIs so that developers can discover and consume them in applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [Apigee API Management](https://cloud.google.com/apigee)

questions.question:

Which Google product or solution should it use?

options.text: Host all your subsidiaries' services on-premises together with your existing services.
Host all your subsidiaries' services together with your existing services on the public cloud.
Build a homogenous infrastructure at each subsidiary, and invest in training their engineers.
Build a homogenous infrastructure at each subsidiary, and invest in hiring more engineers.

questions.explanation:
Hosting the subsidiaries’ services with the existing services on a public cloud centralizes infrastructure operation and lets the provider manage the underlying infrastructure. Public-cloud services scale with demand and use consumption-based pricing, reducing operational overhead and cost while providing security capabilities and reliable service options.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization maintains a large archive of unstructured data, including video and audio files. Which storage solution should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Storage is Google Cloud’s scalable managed object-storage service. It stores unstructured data as objects in buckets and is suitable for large media files such as video and audio archives.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud Storage overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/introduction) · [Best practices for media workloads](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/best-practices-media-workload)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization has recently launched a virtual customer support agent that generates vast quantities of text and speech data.  
  
Why should it use a cloud data warehouse to interpret this data?

options.text: To natively visualize both types of data using a dashboard in real time
To ingest and analyze structured and unstructured data at scale, in real time
To secure data transmission between cloud and on-premises environments
To transform data from structured to unstructured

questions.explanation: A cloud data warehouse supports scalable ingestion and analysis of large volumes of both structured data, such as interaction metadata, and unstructured data, such as customer text and speech content. This enables the organization to derive insights from support-agent data at scale and in real time.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization wants to replicate critical system components to improve reliability and reduce single points of failure. Which design consideration should the organization apply?
questions.explanation: Redundancy provides duplicate critical components so another component can continue operating when one fails, improving reliability and reducing single points of failure.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: What distinguishes Standard storage from Coldline storage?

options.text: Coldline storage is for data for which a slow transfer rate is acceptable.
Standard and Coldline storage have different durability guarantees.
Standard and Coldline storage use different APIs.
Coldline storage is for infrequently accessed data.

questions.explanation:
Coldline storage is designed for data that is accessed infrequently, while Standard storage is intended for frequently accessed data. Cloud Storage storage classes share the same annual durability and a uniform API experience. [Google Cloud Storage classes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/storage-classes)\
\
**Learn more:** [Google Cloud Storage classes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/storage-classes)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is deploying its servers to the cloud by using the infrastructure as a service model.  
  
Under the shared responsibility model, for what is the cloud provider responsible?
questions.explanation:
In infrastructure as a service (IaaS), the customer is responsible for the guest operating system, installed software, and data-access controls. The cloud provider is responsible for security of the underlying cloud infrastructure, including the physical security of its facilities. [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is having difficulty keeping pace with the growth of its application, which runs on legacy infrastructure.  
  
What could be holding the organization back?

options.text: The time it takes their serverless compute function to scale
The overreliance on platform as a service
The inaccessibility of their data due to perimeter security
The cost of provisioning hardware for peak usage

questions.explanation: Legacy infrastructure generally requires hardware to be provisioned for expected peak demand. The upfront expense of acquiring and maintaining that capacity can constrain scaling as application usage grows.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an application programming interface (API)?

To provide cloud plugins for integrated development environments
To connect networks from different cloud providers

questions.question: Which Google Cloud product offers a consistent platform for multicloud application deployments and extends other Google Cloud services into your organization’s environment?

**Learn more:** [Hybrid and multicloud application platform](https://cloud.google.com/solutions/hybrid-and-multicloud-application-platform) · [What are my hybrid and multicloud deployment options with Anthos?](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/developers-practitioners/what-are-my-hybrid-and-multicloud-deployment-options-anthos)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: How does Cloud Debugger help an organization?

options.text: Implement code updates in real time without affecting the service level objective (SLO).
Inspect source code in real time without affecting user downtime.
Manage code and accelerate application development.
Analyze live source code during user downtime.

Cloud Debugger supports real-time inspection of a running application's state at code locations without stopping or slowing the application, allowing production troubleshooting without disrupting users.\

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: How do out-of-the-box APIs make artificial intelligence and machine learning more accessible to all Google Cloud customers?

options.text: They don't require data input and validation.
They all require custom training models.

Out-of-the-box AI/ML APIs provide pre-trained models and ready-made capabilities, allowing customers to integrate AI functions without specialized AI or machine-learning expertise. questions.question: How do out-of-the-box APIs make artificial intelligence and machine learning more accessible to all Google Cloud customers?

options.text: Configure two-factor authentication in the Google domain
Remove the Google account from all IAM policies
Configure BeyondCorp and Identity-Aware Proxy in the Google domain
Configure single sign-on in the Google domain

**Learn more:** [Active Directory single sign-on](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/identity/federating-gcp-with-active-directory-configuring-single-sign-on?hl=en) · [Federate Google Cloud with Active Directory](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/identity/federating-gcp-with-active-directory-introduction)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: When an organization adopts cloud technology, how does its total cost of ownership (TCO) change?

options.text: Away from cost management toward capital expenditure
Away from operational expenditure toward cost management
Away from capital expenditure toward operational expenditure
Away from operational expenditure toward capital expenditure

questions.explanation:
Cloud services replace upfront infrastructure purchases, such as servers and data centers, with variable pay-as-you-go service costs. This shifts spending from capital expenditure (CapEx) to operational expenditure (OpEx).\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of Amazon Web Services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/introduction.html)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization keeps backup files in Cloud Storage. The files are accessed once each year to test disaster-recovery plans. Which storage class is the most cost-effective?
questions.explanation: Archive storage class is most cost-effective for infrequently accessed data with annual access patterns. While Archive has the lowest per-GB storage cost, it carries higher retrieval charges; for disaster-recovery testing accessed once yearly, the storage cost dominates, making Archive the most economical choice. Coldline is appropriate for quarterly or more frequent access patterns.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization keeps backup files in Cloud Storage. The files are accessed once each year to test disaster-recovery plans. Which storage class is the most cost-effective?

options.text: Set up a new billing account in the United States.
Run the application in additional zones in the European region.
Run the application in additional regions in Europe.
Run a replica of the application in a region in the United States.

questions.explanation:
Deploying a replica in a United States region places application resources nearer to United States users, reducing the network-latency component of their requests. Extra zones or regions in Europe improve resilience but do not address the geographic distance to those users. Google Cloud recommends deploying application resources in the region closest to users to optimize network latency.

**Learn more:** [Google Cloud regional deployment archetype](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/deployment-archetypes/regional)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is modifying its gaming product so that it is compatible with cloud technology.

options.text: A shift toward using structured data

questions.question: An information security organization needs to ensure that its service providers hold ISO 27001 certification. It must also be able to access supporting documentation. Which Google Cloud tool should it use?

questions.question: An organization runs multiple containerized workloads and requires complete control over how those workloads are configured. Which Google Cloud service should it use?

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An international law firm requires its HR application to share and access varying volumes of sensitive data among its branch offices.  
  
Why would Cloud Storage be advantageous for the firm?

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An organization contains many teams, and every team owns many Google Cloud projects. The organization wants to make identity and access policy management for these projects simpler.  
  
How should these projects be grouped to achieve this goal?

options.text: Group each team's projects into a separate domain
Assign labels based on the virtual machines that are part of each team's projects
Use folders to group each team's projects
Group each team's projects into a separate organization node

questions.explanation:
Folders group related projects within a Google Cloud organization and provide an administrative boundary. IAM policies granted at a folder are inherited by the projects under that folder, enabling a team’s policies to be managed centrally rather than separately for each project.

questions.question: lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization is designing the resource hierarchy for its new application in Google Cloud. questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization operates many workloads across separate Google Cloud projects, all connected to the same billing account. Each project’s workload costs may change month to month, but the total combined cost across all projects is relatively stable. Your organization needs to optimize costs.  
  
What should the organization do?

options.text: Purchase a commitment per project for each project's usual minimum
Create a billing account per project, and link each project to a different billing account
Turn on committed use discount sharing, and create a commitment for the combined usage
Move all workloads from all different projects into one single consolidated project

A commitment sized to stable combined usage reduces the risk of underutilized per-project commitments when individual project costs vary.

**Learn more:** [Share resource-based CUDs across projects](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/committed-use-discounts/share-resource-cuds-across-projects?hl=en) · [Attribution of committed use discount fees and credits](https://docs.cloud.google.com/docs/cuds-attribution)

questions.question: A cinema company wants to build a model that predicts customer visit patterns for the coming year. Your organization is developing an application that runs in Google Cloud. options.text: Deploy the application on Compute Engine using preemptible instances
Develop the application so it can run in an unmanaged instance group
Create a reservation for the minimum number of Compute Engine instances you will use
Start more instances with fewer virtual centralized processing units (vCPUs) instead of fewer instances with more vCPUs

How should the organization configure support while minimizing costs?

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
Your organization is launching its first publicly available application on Google Cloud. The application is critical to the business and its customers and needs a 2-hour SLA.  
  
How should the organization configure support while minimizing costs?

options.text: Collect all weather data evenly across all cities
Collect all weather data primarily from at-risk cities
Collect extreme weather data evenly across all cities
Collect extreme weather data primarily from at-risk cities

questions.explanation:
The model has to tell extreme weather apart from ordinary weather, so the training set needs the full range of conditions rather than only the extreme events — that rules out the two "extreme weather data" options. It also has to predict for the whole country, so sampling evenly across all cities keeps the data representative.

Concentrating collection on at-risk cities biases the training set toward those locations and their local patterns, which degrades accuracy everywhere else and can make the model overstate risk in cities it saw little of.

**Learn more:** [Google: Data preparation and feature engineering for ML](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/data-prep) · [Best practices for ML on Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/architecture/ml-on-gcp-best-practices)

Which Google Cloud tool should it use?

Which application-modernization approach should the organization choose?

**Learn more:** [Decomposing monoliths into microservices - AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/modernization-decomposing-monoliths/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is developing an application to manage payments and online bank accounts worldwide. The most critical database requirement is that every transaction be processed consistently. The organization expects nearly unlimited growth in the volume of stored data.  
  
Which Google Cloud product should the organization choose?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Spanner provides strongly consistent, ACID transactions with serializability and external consistency, while scaling horizontally across a global deployment. It is suited to financial workloads that require consistent transactions and virtually unlimited data growth.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spanner documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs) · [Transactions overview | Spanner](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/transactions)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: Which technology enables organizations to run multiple computer operating systems on one piece of physical hardware?
questions.explanation: A hypervisor creates and manages virtual machines on a physical host, allowing each virtual machine to run its own operating system.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: Which technology enables organizations to run multiple computer operating systems on one piece of physical hardware?

options.text: You want a balance between flexibility for the customer and the level of management by the cloud provider
You want to minimize the level of management by the customer
You want to maximize flexibility for the customer.
You want to be able to shift your emphasis between flexibility and management by the cloud provider as business needs change

questions.explanation:
SaaS minimizes customer management because the cloud provider operates the application platform, runtime, and underlying cloud resources. The customer retains responsibility for selected areas such as data, access, security configuration, and compliance, but manages less of the technology stack than with PaaS or IaaS.

**Learn more:** [Administer your Azure cloud estate — management scope](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/manage/administer)

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A travel agency wants to share its social-media content seamlessly with partners.  
  
What should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
An application programming interface (API) provides a defined, programmatic interface through which partner applications can access and integrate shared content. APIs enable different software applications to communicate and exchange data or functionality.\
\
**Learn more:** [Developing APIs: A comprehensive guide](https://cloud.google.com/discover/what-is-api-development)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: Your organization wants to minimize its cost for data traffic from the Google network to the internet. What should the organization do?

options.text: Choose the Standard network service tier.
Choose the Premium network service tier.

questions.explanation:
The Standard network service tier is the lower-cost option for internet-facing traffic. It uses public ISP and transit networks rather than carrying traffic across Google’s premium backbone, and Google Cloud documents that Standard Tier is priced lower per GB than Premium Tier.\
\
**Learn more:** [Network Service Tiers overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/network-tiers/docs/overview?hl=en) · [Network Service Tiers pricing](https://cloud.google.com/network-tiers/pricing)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization is building a new container-based application. It does not know how popular the application will be at launch and does not want to pay for idle infrastructure resources. Which serverless-computing benefit addresses this concern?
questions.explanation:
Scalability lets serverless capacity adjust automatically to application demand, scaling down during low utilization so idle infrastructure is not retained and scaling up when demand grows. AWS describes serverless as scaling based on demand with pay-per-value pricing, which reduces capacity-planning effort.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Well-Architected Serverless Applications Lens — Cost-effective resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/serverless-applications-lens/cost-effective-resources.html)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization needs to transform several types of structured and unstructured cloud data from a variety of sources. The data must be easily available for analysis and insights.  
  
Which cloud data storage system should the organization use?
questions.explanation: A data warehouse centralizes and organizes data from multiple sources so it can be readily queried and analyzed to produce insights.

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization needs an open-source machine learning platform to create and deploy its own custom machine learning applications using TPUs.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or service should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
TensorFlow is an open-source, end-to-end machine learning platform for creating and deploying custom models, with support for training on Google TPUs.\
\
**Learn more:** [TensorFlow](https://www.tensorflow.org/) · [Use TPUs | TensorFlow Core](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/tpu)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization has struggled to improve operational efficiency.  
  
Which site reliability engineering (SRE) best practice should it use to increase efficiency?

options.text: Decrease over-reliance on data to make decisions.
Assign exclusive production ownership to developers.
Spend less time measuring outage impact.

questions.explanation: SRE improves operational efficiency by automating toil: repetitive, manual, and operational work with limited enduring value. This frees engineering capacity for reliability improvements and other higher-value work.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization keeps its important industry data in a relational database. It wants to establish a new revenue stream by allowing third parties to use that data in their applications. Which cloud-first approach should the organization select?

options.text: Add third-party users to their database.
Offer chargeable downloads of archived data.
Expose data through a chargeable API.
Transfer data into a non-relational database.

questions.explanation:
A chargeable API provides third parties with controlled, application-ready access to the data while enabling billing based on API usage. API monetization platforms support rate plans and charges for developers’ use of API products.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of Apigee monetization](https://docs.cloud.google.com/apigee/docs/api-platform/monetization/overview?hl=en)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: A financial organization has many customers who close their accounts each year. It wants to use data and AI to identify customers at risk, enabling it to retain them through discounts and improved services. What should the organization do?

options.text: Create a dashboard of previous customers that have exited, and look for obvious correlations in the visualization.
Create a ML model based on the demographics and activities of previous customers that exited.
Create a survey for all customers to identify their current level of satisfaction.
Create a report based on last year’s customer feedback.

questions.explanation: A supervised ML model trained on the demographics and activities of customers who previously exited can learn patterns associated with churn and predict which current customers are likely to leave, allowing targeted retention actions.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization wants to move some of its data out of Google Cloud. Which statement is true?

options.text: Customer data may not be transferred out of Google Cloud.
Customers have full control of their data and may transfer it at any time.
Outgoing data transfer must be enabled in the Google Cloud console.
A technical support ticket must be raised with the correct department.

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud customers control their data and can export or transfer it from Google Cloud using the applicable service capabilities; this does not generally require special console enablement or a support ticket.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google Cloud Data Portability and Switching Procedures](https://cloud.google.com/terms/data-portability) · [Compliance | Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/security/compliance/swipo-codes)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: How does Google Cloud allow customers to harness the power of artificial intelligence and machine learning?

options.text: With scalable on-premises tensor processing units
With APIs and tools for users at different levels of expertise
With affordable and scalable quantum computing
With machine learning models that always require custom training

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud offers AI and machine learning APIs, pretrained models, and development tools that support a range of skill levels, from low-code users to experienced ML engineers. These services allow customers to adopt and deploy AI capabilities without always building and training a model from scratch.\
\
**Learn more:** [AI APIs for Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/ai/apis) · [Google Cloud for AI](https://cloud.google.com/ai?hl=en)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
A public cloud provider’s service-level performance has fallen below the service level objective (SLO), while remaining above the service level agreement (SLA).  
  
What is one outcome of this change in service-level performance?

options.text: The public cloud provider is encouraged to push out new updates
The public cloud provider is encouraged to prioritize service reliability
End users face unexpected or prolonged downtime
End users face a decrease in service latency

questions.explanation: Falling below an SLO signals that the service is not meeting its intended reliability target, even if it is still within the contractual SLA. The provider is therefore encouraged to prioritize service reliability and corrective work.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A public cloud provider’s service-level performance has fallen below the service level objective (SLO), while remaining above the service level agreement (SLA).  
  
What is one outcome of this change in service-level performance?

options.text: Ability to disable regional network connectivity during cyber attacks
Ability to keep backups of their data on-premises in case of failure
Full management access to their regional infrastructure
Reduced likelihood of system failure during high demand events

questions.explanation:
A multi-cloud architecture can provide redundant capacity and enable workloads to scale or fail over across cloud environments, improving resilience during unexpected demand spikes and reducing the risk of service failure. Azure reliability guidance identifies resiliency as the ability to continue operating during infrastructure outages or unexpected spikes in demand.

**Learn more:** [Azure reliability documentation overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/reliability/overview)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: Which item is an example of structured data that a healthcare facility keeps in its system?
questions.explanation: A blood pressure history is structured data because its measurements are recorded in consistent, predefined fields, such as systolic value, diastolic value, date, and time.

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization must categorize a large collection of photographs by using pre-trained machine learning.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or service should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Vision API uses pre-trained vision models to detect labels and categorize image contents across broad categories. AutoML Vision is intended for training custom image-classification models when pre-trained labels are insufficient.\
\
**Learn more:** [Detect Labels | Cloud Vision API](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vision/docs/labels)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization must categorize a large collection of photographs by using pre-trained machine learning.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or service should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Storage Transfer Service provides Google-managed, agent-based transfers from on-premises file systems to Cloud Storage. It supports transfers over private connections such as Cloud Interconnect, allowing the existing Dedicated Interconnect to be used for the automated migration.

**Learn more:** [Transfer from a file system to Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage-transfer/docs/create-transfers/agent-based/file-system-to-cloud-storage?hl=en) · [Protect file system data](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage-transfer/docs/on-prem-security)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: Your organization plans to migrate its data-management solutions to Google Cloud because it needs to scale dynamically up or down and run transactional SQL queries against historical data at scale. Which Google Cloud product or service should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Spanner is a fully managed, horizontally scalable relational database that supports SQL and strongly consistent ACID transactions at global scale, making it suitable for transactional queries over large data volumes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spanner documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs) · [Transactions overview | Spanner](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/transactions?hl=en)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization must store structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data in its raw, native form within the same repository.  
  
Which cloud data-management solution should the organization use?
questions.explanation: A data lake centrally stores structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data in raw, native formats, allowing the data to be retained before transformation or analysis.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization plans to migrate legacy applications that are currently hosted in its data center to the cloud. The existing architecture requires each application to have its own operating system (OS), rather than sharing an OS.  
  
Which infrastructure solution should the organization select?
questions.explanation:
Virtual machines provide isolated guest operating systems and virtualized hardware for individual workloads. This meets the requirement for every application to run with its own OS; traditional containers instead share the host operating system kernel.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is a Virtual Machine?](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/virtual-machine/) · [Docker vs. VM: Difference Between Application Deployment Technologies](https://aws.amazon.com/compare/the-difference-between-docker-vm/)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization wants to more fully understand how its code behaves in production and analyze its state to identify difficult-to-find programming errors.  
  
Which Google Cloud tool should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Google Cloud Debugger enables inspection of an application's production state, including variables and call stacks, at code locations without stopping or slowing the application. It is intended to help find and diagnose difficult production code errors.\
\
**Learn more:** [Diagnose problems in your production apps faster with Google Cloud Debugger](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/gcp/diagnose-problems-in-your-production-apps-faster-with-google-cloud-debugger)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: An organization needs to speed up how quickly it can train machine learning models. Which domain-specific hardware is designed for this purpose?
questions.explanation:
Cloud TPUs are Google-designed ASIC accelerators for machine learning. Their specialized matrix-processing hardware accelerates the computations central to training machine learning models.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introduction to Cloud TPU](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/intro-to-tpu) · [TPU architecture](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tpu/docs/system-architecture-tpu-vm)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization’s web developers and operations staff use separate systems.  
  
How does increasing communication between the teams reduce problems caused by silos?

options.text: By assigning blame for failures and establishing consequences
By combining job role responsibilities to ensure that everyone has shared access
By increasing data encryption to strengthen workflows
By emphasizing shared ownership of business outcomes

questions.explanation: Greater communication reduces silos by aligning development and operations around common goals and collective accountability for business results. Shared ownership encourages collaboration across team boundaries rather than optimizing isolated responsibilities.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A retail organization has migrated all its inventory data to a cloud-based relational database.  
  
What capability does a relational database provide?

options.text: It stores large amounts of raw data in its original format
It stores transactional data, which can then be accessed electronically
It rapidly analyzes large and multi-dimensional datasets
It analyzes unstructured data, which can then be accessed in multiple regions

questions.explanation: A relational database stores structured, transactional records in related tables and makes them available through electronic queries and applications.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
A retail organization has migrated all its inventory data to a cloud-based relational database.  
  
What capability does a relational database provide?

options.text: Secure data access by using Identity and Access Management.
Provide access to third-party developers by creating an API using Apigee.
Create a model in BigQuery to predict future maintenance schedules.
Move data from BigQuery to Cloud Storage to reduce storage costs.

questions.explanation:
BigQuery ML enables machine learning models to be created and used directly with data in BigQuery. A predictive model can use historical charger and customer data to forecast maintenance needs, enabling proactive servicing that reduces unnecessary waste and helps keep the charging network operating efficiently.

**Learn more:** [Model creation | BigQuery | Google Cloud Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/model-overview) · [The ML.PREDICT function | BigQuery | Google Cloud Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/bigqueryml-syntax-predict)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: An organization has hired a team of data scientists and developers. They want to create distinctive business value by coding an advanced machine learning model in Vertex AI Workbench. Which service should the organization use to train the model?
questions.explanation:
Vertex AI Custom Training supports training custom models with the organization’s own training code and preferred machine learning framework. AutoML is intended for model training without writing code, while Compute Engine is general infrastructure and prebuilt APIs provide ready-made capabilities rather than custom-model training.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introduction to Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/ai-platform/docs/technical-overview)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
Your organization needs to establish private network connectivity between its on-premises network and workloads running in Google Cloud. You need to set up the connection as soon as possible.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or feature should you use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud VPN securely connects an on-premises network to a Google Cloud VPC through IPsec VPN tunnels and can be configured promptly over existing internet connectivity. It avoids the provisioning time associated with Cloud Interconnect.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud VPN overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/network-connectivity/docs/vpn/concepts/overview) · [Choosing a Network Connectivity product](https://docs.cloud.google.com/network-connectivity/docs/how-to/choose-product)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: What should customers expect when their cloud provider fails to meet its service level agreement (SLA)?
questions.explanation: When a cloud provider does not meet an SLA, the agreement commonly provides a financial remedy such as a service credit or refund for the service interruption.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: What benefit would an organization gain from using Looker?
questions.explanation:
Looker is a business intelligence and analytics platform that enables organizations to analyze governed data, create reports and dashboards, and deliver data insights. It is not primarily an identity-management service, a serverless warehouse, or a data rollback tool.\
\
**Learn more:** [Looker documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/looker/docs) · [Looker for Business Intelligence](https://cloud.google.com/looker-bi)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: What benefit would an organization gain from using Looker?

options.text: Define an organization policy at the root organization node to restrict virtual machine instances from having an external IP address
Define an organization policy on all existing folders to define a constraint to restrict virtual machine instances from having an external IP address
Define an organization policy on all existing projects to restrict virtual machine instances from having an external IP address
Communicate with the different teams and agree that each time a virtual machine is created, it must be configured without an external IP address

questions.explanation:
The Compute Engine external-IP organization-policy constraint prevents VM instances from using external IPv4 addresses. An organization policy applied at the root organization node is inherited by descendant folders and projects, including those created later, so it centrally enforces the restriction across the organization.

**Learn more:** [Organization policy constraints](https://docs.cloud.google.com/organization-policy/reference/org-policy-constraints) · [About the Google Cloud resource hierarchy](https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/cloud-platform-resource-hierarchy)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
Your company has been using a shared facility for data storage and will migrate to Google Cloud. One internal application uses custom Linux images that must be migrated.  
  
Which Google Cloud product should you use to maintain the custom images?
questions.explanation:
Compute Engine manages custom OS images. Custom Linux images can be imported or created in a project and used to create Compute Engine VM instances.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create custom images | Compute Engine](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/images/create-custom) · [OS images | Compute Engine](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/images)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization achieves its service level objective (SLO) of 99.999% (`five nines`).  
  
How much downtime do its end users experience each year?
questions.explanation: An availability target of 99.999% allows 0.001% downtime. Over one year, that is approximately 5.26 minutes of unavailable service.

Private Google Access, enabled on the VPC subnet, lets VMs with no external IP addresses access Google APIs and services using their internal IP addresses. This supports access to BigQuery and Cloud Storage public API endpoints while preventing general public-internet access.

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization wants to improve the skills of its IT staff.  
  
How can it accomplish this in a transformational way?

options.text: Prioritize training current employees instead of hiring new recruits with cloud experience.
Prioritize giving privileged access to third-party partners and contractors to fill IT knowledge gaps.
Create a culture of self-motivated, isolated learning with official training materials.
Create a culture of continuous peer-to-peer learning with official training materials.

questions.explanation: A continuous, peer-to-peer learning culture supported by official training materials embeds skill development into everyday work, spreads knowledge across the team, and supports lasting organizational transformation.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An employee gets an email from their internet service provider requesting their bank account number and password.  
  
Which cybersecurity threat does this represent?
questions.explanation: Phishing uses deceptive messages that appear to come from a trusted source to persuade recipients to disclose sensitive information, such as account details and passwords.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: How does the Google Cloud resource hierarchy enable organizations to enforce security policies?

options.text: Policies can be applied at the folder level and are inherited by projects inside the folder.
Projects in the resource hierarchy are not affected by security policies.
Policies can only be applied at the organization level and affect all projects.
Policies can only be applied to individual projects.

questions.explanation:
Folder resources act as policy inheritance points for Google Cloud policies. Policies applied to a folder are inherited by projects beneath that folder, enabling consistent security controls across related projects.\
\
**Learn more:** [About resource hierarchy](https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/cloud-platform-resource-hierarchy) · [Organization Policy overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/organization-policy/overview)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
Your organization is planning a migration to Google Cloud.  
  
What is a best practice for initially configuring your Google Cloud environment?

options.text: Create a project via Google Cloud Console per department in your company
Define your resource hierarchy with an organization node on top
Create projects based on team members' requests
Make every member of your company the project owner

questions.explanation:
An organization resource should be the root of the Google Cloud resource hierarchy. It centrally owns projects and folders, and provides inheritance points for IAM access controls and organization policies across descendant resources.\
\
**Learn more:** [About resource hierarchy | Resource Manager | Google Cloud Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/cloud-platform-resource-hierarchy)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization is concerned that one of its applications takes too long to return a result. According to Google’s “Four Golden Signals,” which signal measures this aspect of the application’s performance?
questions.explanation:
Latency measures the time needed to service a request, so it captures applications that are taking too long to return results.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google SRE Book — Monitoring Distributed Systems](https://sre.google/sre-book/monitoring-distributed-systems/)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization wants to use several marketing datasets to predict user acquisition.  
  
How should it use cloud technology to obtain new insights from the data?

options.text: Import the datasets into a custom data warehouse, and then archive old data
Import and selectively archive the datasets in a custom data lake
Separate the datasets and make predictions using machine learning
Combine the datasets and make predictions using machine learning

questions.explanation: Combining the marketing datasets creates a unified set of features and relationships for analysis. Machine-learning models can then use that integrated data to predict user acquisition; simply storing, archiving, or separating the datasets does not generate the forecast.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations

An organization wants to use several marketing datasets to predict user acquisition.  
  
How should it use cloud technology to obtain new insights from the data?

Cloud Functions provides serverless, event-driven execution for lightweight code. It can respond to Firebase Realtime Database events and integrate with services such as Pub/Sub and Cloud APIs; the platform manages the underlying infrastructure and automatically scales with workload, including to zero when idle.
