questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
Your organization is building a mobile app and wants to choose a fully featured, cloud-based compute platform for it.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or feature should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Firebase is a comprehensive platform for building mobile applications, combining mobile-focused services such as authentication, cloud data storage and synchronization, hosting, messaging, analytics, and serverless functions. Google Cloud describes mobile application platforms as providing a comprehensive backend and tools for iOS and Android applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is an application platform?](https://cloud.google.com/discover/what-is-an-application-platform) · [Firestore](https://cloud.google.com/products/firestore?hl=en)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization has begun developing cloud-native applications to replace its legacy applications.  
  
What else should the organization do to adopt the cloud?

options.text: Provide privileged cloud network access to third-party partners.
Migrate some of their legacy infrastructure to the cloud.
Conduct maintenance on their legacy hardware.

questions.explanation: Cloud adoption includes modernizing applications and migrating suitable legacy infrastructure or workloads to cloud services. This reduces reliance on the legacy environment and advances the organization’s transition to the cloud.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization has begun developing cloud-native applications to replace its legacy applications.  
  
What else should the organization do to adopt the cloud?

options.text: Use a committed use discount to reserve a very powerful virtual machine
Purchase one very powerful physical computer
Start a very powerful virtual machine without using a committed use discount
Purchase multiple physical computers and scale workload across them

questions.explanation:
Compute Engine committed use discounts require a one- or three-year commitment and incur commitment charges for the entire term, including periods when the resources are not used. For a two-week, temporary capacity need, an on-demand virtual machine avoids long-term commitment and physical-hardware acquisition costs while allowing the resources to be stopped when the need ends.

**Learn more:** [Committed use discounts for Compute Engine](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/committed-use-discounts-overview?hl=en) · [VM instance pricing](https://cloud.google.com/products/compute/pricing)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization processes batch sales data at the end of each month to analyze sales trends and gain business insights. It wants to improve accuracy and make near-real-time decisions. What should the organization do?

options.text: Change from a relational database to a NoSQL database.
Filter the data so reports are generated faster.
Switch from batch processing to stream processing.
Process batch reports weekly instead of monthly.

questions.explanation: Stream processing continuously processes incoming sales data, reducing the delay inherent in end-of-month batch jobs and enabling near-real-time analysis and decision-making.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization is concerned about its cloud costs. It wants to be notified when spending exceeds a specified threshold, instead of waiting to review its bill at the end of the month. What should the organization do?

options.text: Pause virtual machines during non-business hours.
Configure a budget threshold rule and alert.
Use historical cost data to predict future overspend.

questions.explanation:
A Cloud Billing budget with an alert threshold rule sends a notification when actual or forecasted spending exceeds the configured threshold, enabling timely awareness before the end-of-month bill.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create, edit, or delete budgets and budget alerts](https://cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/budgets)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization wants to use tooling and automation as part of its new DevOps philosophy.  
  
Which operational challenge will this address?

options.text: Repetitive manual tasks that hinder workflows
Defective technical equipment that limits innovation

questions.explanation: DevOps tooling and automation reduce repetitive manual operational work by standardizing and accelerating workflows, improving consistency and delivery efficiency.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
Your organization needs a cost-effective solution to store data such as files, graphical images, and videos, and to access and share that data securely.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or service should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Storage is scalable managed object storage for unstructured data such as files, images, and videos. It supports cost-optimized storage classes and secure access and sharing through IAM permissions, while Cloud SQL and Cloud Spanner are relational databases and BigQuery is an analytics service.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud Storage overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/introduction)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: An organization needs to create custom machine learning models. It requires a managed platform offering services to collect data, build models, and deploy and monitor those models. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation:
Vertex AI is Google Cloud’s managed machine-learning platform for the end-to-end ML workflow, including data and feature capabilities, custom training, model deployment, and model monitoring.\
\
**Learn more:** [Vertex AI documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs) · [Introduction to Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/ai-platform/docs/technical-overview)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to create custom machine learning models. It requires a managed platform offering services to collect data, build models, and deploy and monitor those models. Which service should it use?

options.text: In a single zone within a single region
In different zones within a single region
In multiple regions, using one zone per region
In multiple regions, using multiple zones per region

questions.explanation:
Compute Engine zones within the same region are separate failure domains, providing redundancy, and have high-bandwidth, low-latency network connections to one another. Communication within a region is generally faster than communication across regions, so distributing the VMs across different zones in one region best satisfies both requirements.

**Learn more:** [Regions and zones | Compute Engine | Google Cloud Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/regions-zones)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An international bank needs a serverless data warehouse solution that enables smart analytics.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or service should the bank use?
questions.explanation:
BigQuery is a fully managed, serverless data warehouse designed to store and analyze data at scale, with built-in capabilities for analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence.\
\
**Learn more:** [BigQuery overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/introduction?hl=en)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A food delivery service requires real-time access to menu information from every partner restaurant. It also needs to share customer order information with those restaurants in real time.  
  
What should the organization use?
questions.explanation: An application programming interface (API) enables separate systems to exchange structured data in real time, allowing the delivery service to retrieve current restaurant menus and transmit customer orders to restaurant systems.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
A food delivery service requires real-time access to menu information from every partner restaurant. It also needs to share customer order information with those restaurants in real time.  
  
What should the organization use?

options.text: Agile infrastructure means that they only pay for what they need, when they need it.
Operational expenditure means that their total cost of ownership is more predictable.
Unlimited storage means that their website will never experience downtime.
Shared responsibility means that the cloud provider brings increased visibility during peaks in traffic.

questions.explanation:
Cloud infrastructure supports elastic, on-demand resource provisioning, so capacity can increase for traffic peaks and decrease afterward. The consumption model charges for the computing resources used, reducing the cost of maintaining capacity solely for peak demand.

**Learn more:** [Six advantages of cloud computing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/six-advantages-of-cloud-computing.html) · [Manage demand and supply resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2024-06-27/framework/cost-mandem.html)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization wants to build completely new cloud infrastructure and applications.  
  
Which application-modernization approach should the organization choose?

options.text: Move the application to the cloud, and then change it.
Change their application, and then move it to the cloud.

questions.explanation:
Greenfield development creates a system from scratch for a completely new environment and does not involve legacy code. It fits an organization building new infrastructure and applications directly in the cloud, whereas brownfield modernization occurs in the context of existing or legacy systems.\
\
**Learn more:** [Decomposing monoliths into microservices – AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/modernization-decomposing-monoliths/welcome.html)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: A vacation-home rental organization wants to forecast the popularity of properties for its upcoming busy season. It has no data science team and wants to apply its in-house database administration expertise to build a machine learning model. What should the organization do?

options.text: Use custom training in Vertex AI with TensorFlow.
Integrate pre-trained APIs into their application.
Use BigQuery ML and create models using SQL.
Build a model in AutoML using labeled data.

questions.explanation: BigQuery ML enables teams to create and run machine learning models directly with SQL in BigQuery. This suits an organization whose available expertise is database administration rather than data science or custom machine learning development.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization has petabytes of data collected from a broad range of sources. It wants to use that data for strategic analysis and to inform business decisions. What type of service should it use?
questions.explanation: A data warehouse consolidates large volumes of data from multiple sources and is optimized for analytical queries, reporting, and business intelligence that support strategic decision-making.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: How does Google Cloud make sure that customer data remains secure and private while at rest?

options.text: By aggregating training data for customers within each industry
By automatically locking files containing suspicious code
By auditing platform privacy practices against industry standards
By providing privacy reviews for critical customer applications

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud regularly undergoes independent verification through certifications, attestations, and audit reports that map its security and privacy controls to recognized industry standards. This provides assurance that its data-protection practices meet established privacy and security requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google Cloud Compliance Resource Center](https://cloud.google.com/compliance)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud

options.text: Migrate the workloads to Google Cloud VMware Engine
Migrate the workloads to Compute Engine
Migrate the workloads to Bare Metal Solution
Migrate the workloads to Google Kubernetes Engine

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud VMware Engine provides a fully managed VMware platform on Google Cloud, allowing VMware-based workloads to be migrated while retaining the existing VMware environment and requiring minimal changes to applications, tools, and processes. It is therefore the best fit for a rapid migration from a hypervisor-based private cloud while maximizing use of managed services.

**Learn more:** [Google Cloud VMware Engine](https://cloud.google.com/vmware-engine) · [Migrating VMware VMs to your private cloud](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vmware-engine/docs/workloads/howto-migrate-workloads)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to analyze data in a data warehouse. How should it proceed?

options.text: Import data into a semi-structured time-series database.
Choose a system to store structured and semi-structured data that supports ad-hoc analysis and custom reporting.
Copy unstructured data into a single large object store.
Ensure data is stored in structured tables and rows to support transactional queries and relationships.

questions.explanation: A data warehouse supports analytical workloads such as ad-hoc analysis and custom reporting, using structured data and commonly accommodating semi-structured data as well. Transactional queries and relationship-focused table design are primarily OLTP concerns.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: When is data automatically encrypted in Google Cloud?

options.text: When it is in transit only,
When it is at rest and in transit.
Data is not automatically encrypted by default.
When it is at rest only.

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud applies default encryption to customer content at rest and provides encryption for data in transit, without requiring customer action for those standard protections.\
\
**Learn more:** [Encryption for Cloud Security](https://cloud.google.com/security/encryption)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization must search an application's source code to identify a possible issue. The application is distributed across multiple containers.  
  
Which Google Cloud product should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Logging centralizes log entries from application workloads, including container resources, and provides querying and search through Logs Explorer to investigate potential issues across multiple containers. Cloud Trace follows request latency across services, while Cloud Monitoring focuses on metrics, dashboards, and alerts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud Logging documentation](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs) · [View logs by using the Logs Explorer](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/overview)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization needs complete control of its virtual machine infrastructure for a custom, home-grown application, using a product that autoscales and updates automatically.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or solution should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Compute Engine provides control over VM infrastructure. Its managed instance groups can automatically add or remove VMs in response to load and can automatically roll out VM configuration updates.\
\
**Learn more:** [Instance groups | Compute Engine](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instance-groups) · [Autoscaling groups of instances | Compute Engine](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/autoscaler)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: Your organization plans to migrate its on-premises environment to Google Cloud. The on-premises environment includes containers and virtual machine instances. Which Google Cloud products can help migrate the container images and the virtual machine disks?
questions.explanation:
Artifact Registry stores and manages Docker and OCI container images. Virtual disk image files must be added to Cloud Storage before they can be imported into a Compute Engine image, making Cloud Storage the appropriate service for the disk-migration staging step.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with container images | Artifact Registry](https://docs.cloud.google.com/artifact-registry/docs/docker) · [Import virtual disks | Compute Engine](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/import/importing-virtual-disks)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization is training a machine learning model to generate predictions.  
  
What could improve the model’s prediction accuracy?
questions.explanation: Increasing the amount of relevant, high-quality training data can improve a model’s ability to learn underlying patterns and generalize accurately to new inputs. Greater storage capacity, network bandwidth, or CPU speed can support training operations but does not by itself improve prediction accuracy.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization is assessing its defenses against cybersecurity threats and is concerned about the risk of cybercriminal social-engineering attacks. How could these attacks occur?
questions.explanation: Phishing emails are a social-engineering technique: they deceive people into taking actions such as disclosing credentials or opening malicious links.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is finding it difficult to meet user demand for change and wants to modernize its legacy applications by moving those applications to the cloud.  
  
Why would this enable the organization to meet user expectations?

options.text: Customer data can be used to offer tailored content
Toil automation helps make automatic updates
Updates can be pushed out more quickly to repair bugs
DevOps requires that industry trends be measured and tracked

questions.explanation: Cloud modernization can support faster software delivery and deployment, enabling updates to be released more rapidly to fix defects and respond to user needs.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is finding it difficult to meet user demand for change and wants to modernize its legacy applications by moving those applications to the cloud.  
  
Why would this enable the organization to meet user expectations?

options.text: Export the VMs into VMDK format, and import them into Compute Engine
Export the VMs into VMDK format, and import them into Google Cloud VMware Engine
Migrate the workloads using Migrate for Compute Engine
Migrate the workloads using Migrate for Anthos

questions.explanation:
Migrate for Anthos is designed to modernize existing Linux and Windows VM workloads by converting them into containers for deployment on Google Kubernetes Engine or Anthos. Containerizing the workloads provides a cloud-native Kubernetes-based target, unlike VMDK import or VM migration to Compute Engine, which preserves the VM deployment model.

**Learn more:** [Streamline your application migration journey with Migrate for Anthos and GKE](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/developers-practitioners/streamline-your-application-migration-journey-migrate-anthos-and-gke/) · [Migrate to Containers release notes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/migrate/containers/docs/release-notes)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization wants to run its custom application in the cloud in a flexible, scalable manner without having to manage any infrastructure. Which service model should it use?
questions.explanation: Platform as a service (PaaS) provides a managed environment for deploying custom applications, with the provider operating the underlying infrastructure and supporting scalable application hosting.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
Your team is releasing research findings and must make large volumes of data available to other researchers in the professional community and to the public at the lowest possible cost.  
  
How should the data be hosted?

options.text: Use a Cloud Storage bucket and enable ג€Requester Pays.ג€
Use a Cloud Storage bucket and provide Signed URLs for the data files.
Use a Cloud Storage bucket and set up a Cloud Interconnect connection to allow access to the data.
Host the data on-premises, and set up a Cloud Interconnect connection to allow access to the data.

questions.explanation:
Cloud Storage Requester Pays requires a requester to specify a billing project for access, so the requester is charged for the applicable access costs. This lets the publisher make large datasets available while minimizing the publisher’s distribution expense.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use Requester Pays | Cloud Storage](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/using-requester-pays)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: How is privacy characterized in the context of cloud technology?

options.text: Restrictions on data access and sharing
Susceptibility to data breaches and cyber attacks

questions.explanation: Privacy is the control and restriction of access to data and of how that data is shared.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization must deploy frequent updates to its business application.  
  
Why should the organization use Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)?

options.text: Customer expectations can be adjusted without using marketing tools
Seamless changes can be made without causing any application downtime.
GKE handles version control seamlessly and out of the box
GKE is well suited for all monolithic applications

questions.explanation:
GKE supports Kubernetes rolling-update deployment patterns, which update a subset of running application instances at a time while the remaining instances continue to serve traffic. This enables application changes to be deployed without downtime when the workload is configured appropriately.\
\
**Learn more:** [Best practices for continuous integration and delivery to Google Kubernetes Engine](https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/concepts/best-practices-continuous-integration-delivery-kubernetes)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization is worried about the risk of data loss caused by hardware failures or cyberattacks. It wants to restore its systems to an earlier state if such an incident occurs. What should the organization do?
questions.explanation: Regular backups preserve recoverable copies of data and, where configured, system state, enabling restoration after hardware failure, accidental loss, or a cyberattack.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization has a small development team that built a web application running in a single container. They need a simple, serverless, scalable way to host that container. Which Google service should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Run is a fully managed, serverless platform for deploying and running containerized applications on scalable Google infrastructure. It removes the need to create or manage servers or Kubernetes clusters while automatically scaling the web application.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Cloud Run](https://docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/overview/what-is-cloud-run)

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: How does a large hotel chain gain from storing its customer reservation data in the cloud?

options.text: On-premises hardware access to transaction data
Real-time data transformation at scale within an on-premises database
Real-time business transaction accuracy at scale
Physical hardware access during peak demand

questions.explanation: Cloud storage and services can scale to support large volumes of concurrent reservation activity while keeping transaction data current and accurate in real time.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization wants to add a new capability to its application. They want to write the code while having the public cloud provider manage the infrastructure.  
  
Which infrastructure solution should they use?
questions.explanation: Serverless computing lets developers deploy and run code without provisioning or managing the underlying servers and infrastructure; the cloud provider handles that operational responsibility.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization’s public-cloud provider did not meet its 99.99% availability SLA.  
  
What could be the potential impact on the organization?

options.text: The organization risks using up their error budget.
Renegotiation of the SLA to put less emphasis on uptime could be necessary.
Unexpected downtime could risk the loss of customers.
All data stored in their database could be unexpectedly lost.

questions.explanation: Unexpected downtime can interrupt customer access to services and erode customer trust, which can result in lost customers.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization operates a batch data-analysis workload on a virtual machine (VM). The workload can be restarted easily without losing work and is not time-critical. The organization must select the lowest-cost option for running the workload. Which option should it choose?

options.text: A Preemptible or Spot VM on Compute Engine
A custom VM in a pay-as-you-go model on Compute Engine
A standard VM in a pay-as-you-go model on Compute Engine
A Cloud Function with a small memory limit

questions.explanation:
Compute Engine Spot VMs use discounted excess capacity and may be preempted at any time. They are intended for fault-tolerant batch workloads that can be restarted, making them the lowest-cost suitable choice when timely completion is not required.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spot VMs — Compute Engine documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/spot?hl=en) · [Spot VM pricing — Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/spot-vms/pricing)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is deploying applications to the cloud by using platform as a service.  
  
Under the shared responsibility model, what remains the customer organization's responsibility?
questions.explanation: For platform as a service (PaaS), the cloud provider manages the underlying infrastructure and platform operations, including physical security and core network security. The customer remains responsible for governing its data, including defining and enforcing data access policies.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization has just completed a migration from on-premises infrastructure to Google Cloud.  
  
How has cost management changed?

options.text: Costs will primarily shift from CapEx to OpEx.
Costs will primarily shift from OpEx to CapEx.
Cost management will stay the same, but the total cost of ownership (TCO) will be lower.
Cost management will stay the same, but the total cost of ownership (TCO) will be higher.

questions.explanation:
Google Cloud resource costs are generally incurred as the resources are consumed and treated as operational expenditure (OpEx), unlike on-premises hardware and software acquisition costs, which are capital expenditures (CapEx).\
\
**Learn more:** [Well-Architected Framework: Cost optimization pillar](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/framework/cost-optimization)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization needs frequent access to only a subset of its data. It wants to lower costs by placing the remainder of its data in Nearline, Coldline, and Archive repositories.  
  
Which Google Cloud product should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Storage provides the Nearline, Coldline, and Archive storage classes for infrequently accessed data, allowing storage costs to be reduced while retaining access to the objects. [Google Cloud Storage classes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/storage-classes)\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud Storage classes](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/storage-classes)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: What is an advantage of using a serverless service for a data-processing pipeline?

options.text: Full control over compute resources is provided.
Processed data will not require analysis.
Pipeline infrastructure is fully managed and scalable.
Processed data is guaranteed to be free of errors.

questions.explanation:
A serverless data-processing pipeline removes the need to provision and manage its underlying infrastructure while scaling resources to meet processing demand. AWS Glue, for example, provides a fully managed serverless toolkit for data pipelines and automatically scales processing jobs. \
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Glue — Serverless Data Integration](https://aws.amazon.com/glue/)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: What is an advantage of using a serverless service for a data-processing pipeline?

options.text: Provide staff identities using only Google Cloud authentication.
Provide multiple layers of network security using a zero-trust model.
Emphasize strong perimeter security and trust in their private network.
Emphasize three main Identity Access Management roles: owner, editor, and viewer.

questions.explanation:
A transformational cloud security strategy applies defense in depth and zero trust: no user, device, or network location is inherently trusted, and access is explicitly verified through multiple, integrated security layers. Google Cloud recommends a zero-trust model and a layered security approach rather than reliance on perimeter trust.

**Learn more:** [Implement zero trust | Cloud Architecture Center](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/framework/security/implement-zero-trust) · [Implement security by design | Cloud Architecture Center](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/framework/security/implement-security-by-design)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization uses machine learning to generate predictions. One of its datasets accidentally contains incorrectly labeled data.  
  
How will this affect the predictions?
questions.explanation: Incorrect labels corrupt the training signal used to learn the relationship between inputs and target values, increasing the risk that the model produces inaccurate predictions.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
After deploying a new update, an organization discovers a minor bug in its online video game.  
  
How should the organization handle this bug while adhering to SRE principles?

options.text: Accept and learn from the bug because failure is normal
Accept and ignore the bug because it is only minor
Hold a postmortem to reprimand the employee responsible for the bug
Document bug correction to eliminate all future bugs

questions.explanation: SRE recognizes that failure is normal in complex systems and promotes learning from incidents to improve reliability. This approach favors accepting the bug as an opportunity to learn, rather than ignoring it, assigning blame, or expecting to eliminate every future bug.

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
Your organization needs to predict the behavior of visitors to its public website. To accomplish this, you have decided to build a machine learning model. Your team has database-related skills but only basic machine learning skills and wants to use those database skills.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or feature should your organization select?
questions.explanation:
BigQuery ML enables SQL practitioners to build, train, evaluate, and run machine learning models directly in BigQuery using familiar SQL tools and skills. It is therefore suited to teams with database expertise and limited machine learning experience.\
\
**Learn more:** [Introduction to ML in BigQuery](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/bqml-introduction) · [Create an ML model in BigQuery ML by using SQL](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/create-machine-learning-model?hl=en)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A global organization is building an application to manage payments and online bank accounts across multiple regions. Every transaction must be processed consistently in its database, and the organization expects nearly unlimited growth in stored data.  
  
Which Google Cloud product should the organization select?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Spanner provides strongly consistent, externally consistent transactions for globally distributed data and scales horizontally to handle extremely large datasets and workloads. These capabilities suit multi-region payment and banking-account transactions that require consistent database state at virtually unlimited scale.\
\
**Learn more:** [Spanner documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs) · [Transactions overview | Spanner](https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/transactions?hl=en)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
A cloud-native organization is failing to meet its service level objective (SLO), but it has not used up its error budget.  
  
What should the organization prioritize?

options.text: Stability to avoid prolonged user downtime

questions.explanation:
An unexhausted error budget permits continued innovation and feature-oriented work because error budgets balance reliability against the pace of development. Stability-focused restrictions, such as halting changes to reduce risk, are typically applied once the error budget is exhausted or nearly exhausted.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google SRE Book: Embracing Risk](https://sre.google/sre-book/embracing-risk/) · [Google SRE Workbook: Example Error Budget Policy](https://sre.google/workbook/error-budget-policy/)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
A cloud-native organization is failing to meet its service level objective (SLO), but it has not used up its error budget.  
  
What should the organization prioritize?
questions.explanation:
Compute Engine committed use discounts are intended for predictable, steady-state usage, and a three-year plan provides a greater discount than a one-year plan. A commitment must be paid for throughout its term whether or not the committed resources are used, so only the continuously required 200 CPUs should be committed. The intermittent capacity above that baseline should be paid for as needed.

**Learn more:** [Committed use discounts (CUDs) for Compute Engine](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/committed-use-discounts-overview) · [Resource-based committed use discounts](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instances/signing-up-committed-use-discounts)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An organization is planning its cloud spending.  
  
What should the organization do to manage costs?

options.text: Consider cloud resource costs as capital expenditure in annual planning.
Use only cloud resources; they have no cloud infrastructure costs.
Review cloud resource costs frequently because costs depend on usage.
Assess cloud resources costs only when SLO is not met by their cloud provider.

questions.explanation:
Cloud-resource charges are usage-dependent and can change as workloads, capacity, and consumption change. Frequent cost and usage reviews enable the organization to identify changes, forecast spend, and take optimization action. AWS Well-Architected guidance identifies expenditure and usage awareness as a cost-optimization practice and recommends regular reporting and analysis of cost and usage.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization has petabytes of data collected from a broad range of sources. It wants to use this data for strategic analysis and to inform business decisions. What type of service should it use?
questions.explanation: Among the available options, a multi-cloud environment best supports the stated goal of ingesting petabytes of data from diverse sources and enabling strategic analysis. A multi-cloud approach provides flexibility to integrate data and analytics services from multiple cloud providers, though the question set lacks a dedicated data warehouse or analytics service option.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to build a data pipeline that transforms its data so that it can be reconciled in a data warehouse. The solution must scale and require little to no management. Which Google product or service should the organization select?
questions.explanation:
Dataflow is a fully managed, scalable data-processing service for batch and streaming pipelines. It is designed for ETL workloads that read data, transform it, and write it to a destination such as a data warehouse; Google manages the processing resources and Dataflow can autoscale workers as demand changes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Dataflow overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/dataflow/docs/overview)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: An organization needs a purpose-built AI solution to improve efficiency and deliver personalized interactions for its customer care team. Which Google Cloud AI solution should it use?
questions.explanation:
Contact Center AI is designed for contact-center customer service. Its AI capabilities support efficient customer care through agent assistance, automation, and intelligent routing while enabling personalized interactions across customer channels.\
\
**Learn more:** [Contact Center AI (CCAI) Platform](https://cloud.google.com/solutions/contact-center-ai-platform)

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization is building an application that will collect a large volume of data from millions of distinct sensor devices located throughout the world. The organization requires a database appropriate for global, high-speed storage of large volumes of unstructured data.  
  
Which Google Cloud product should the organization select?

**Learn more:** [Bigtable overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigtable/docs/overview) · [Bigtable: fast, flexible NoSQL](https://cloud.google.com/bigtable)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: What advantage does the OpEx model offer for cloud security?

options.text: Organizations do not need to make upfront capital investments in cloud security.
Organizations can deploy custom security hardware.
Organizations do not need to configure any security settings for cloud resources.

questions.explanation:
An OpEx cloud model replaces large up-front capital infrastructure expenditures with variable, consumption-based costs, allowing organizations to obtain cloud security capabilities without an up-front capital investment. Cloud security still follows a shared-responsibility model, so customers retain configuration responsibilities.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of Amazon Web Services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/introduction.html) · [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization needs to search hundreds of scanned documents for key details such as dates, names, and other specific words.  
  
Why should the organization use application programming interfaces (APIs)?

options.text: To replace the scanned documents with an online survey
To ingest data in real time and encrypt unmatched words
To create digital versions of the documents and locate key information
To transform the documents into unstructured data.

questions.explanation: Document-processing and OCR APIs can programmatically convert scanned documents into machine-readable digital content and extract or find important information, including dates, names, and specified words.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: Which Google Cloud product is intended to reduce the risks of handling personally identifiable information (PII)?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Data Loss Prevention detects and de-identifies PII through techniques such as masking, redaction, and tokenization, reducing exposure to raw sensitive identifiers during data handling.\
\
**Learn more:** [De-identifying sensitive data](https://docs.cloud.google.com/sensitive-data-protection/docs/deidentify-sensitive-data) · [Sensitive Data Protection](https://cloud.google.com/security/products/sensitive-data-protection)

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A venue that uses an online booking system has formed a partnership with a catering business.  
  
How can the venue use application programming interfaces (APIs) to generate new business value?

options.text: Use an API to redesign their booking system to appeal to targeted customers
Use an API to identify opportunities for new business collaboration
Use an API to migrate all their customer data to a machine learning model to predict food requests
Use an API to connect their booking system with the partner's catering form

questions.explanation: APIs enable separate applications to communicate and share relevant booking information. Connecting the venue’s booking system to the catering partner’s form can streamline catering requests and create an integrated service for customers.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization must store daily transactional data, including customer records and purchase history. The data has a consistent schema and is cross-referenced. Which type of service should the organization use?
questions.explanation: A relational database stores structured transactional data in related tables, using keys to represent and query cross-referenced customer and purchase records while maintaining a consistent schema.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to control which types of network traffic may enter and leave its network and access its applications. Which security measure should it use?
questions.explanation: Firewall rules filter network traffic by allowing or denying inbound and outbound connections according to defined criteria, thereby controlling access to networked applications.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization operates an on-premises IT infrastructure. Its customer-facing application repeatedly fails during periods of peak usage.  
  
What could be causing this issue?

options.text: A serverless compute function struggles to scale.
They don't have enough servers to meet the demand.
The application is only configurable on-premises.

questions.explanation:
An application can fail under peak load when the available server capacity cannot handle the current traffic demand. Capacity that is too low leads to resource saturation, increased latency, and errors; autoscaling is used to keep capacity aligned with demand.\
\
**Learn more:** [Auto Scaling benefits for application architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-benefits.html)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization needs to collect and store every log generated by applications running in Google Cloud. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud Logging is the managed Google Cloud service for collecting, storing, searching, and analyzing application and platform log data. Application logs can be sent to Cloud Logging, where they are retained in log buckets.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud Logging overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/logging/docs/overview?hl=en) · [Store log entries](https://docs.cloud.google.com/logging/docs/store-log-entries)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization needs a storage solution to serve content to users around the world. It requires a solution that provides a high level of availability.  
  
Which Cloud Storage feature would be most beneficial?
questions.explanation:
Multi-regional storage provides geographically distributed redundancy and is intended for content serving. Cloud Storage multi-region buckets remain available during a region-wide outage without requiring a storage-path change, supporting highly available access for widely distributed users.\
\
**Learn more:** [Bucket locations | Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/bucket-locations) · [Data availability and durability | Cloud Storage](https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/availability-durability)

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: Why should an organization consider total cost of ownership (TCO) when migrating from on premises to the cloud?
questions.explanation: Total cost of ownership accounts for the complete costs of each environment, enabling an organization to assess the financial benefits and return on investment of a cloud migration.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization wants to use BigQuery data analytics to understand its website performance, but wants to move only some data to the cloud.  
  
Which environment should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
A hybrid cloud combines public-cloud resources, such as BigQuery in Google Cloud, with private or on-premises infrastructure. It lets an organization keep part of its data outside the public cloud while moving the data needed for cloud analytics.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is a Hybrid Cloud?](https://cloud.google.com/learn/what-is-hybrid-cloud)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to confirm the identity of a user requesting access to a system. Which cloud identity-management aspect does this activity describe?
questions.explanation: Authentication verifies that a user is the identity they claim to be before access is granted.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization needs a hybrid-cloud management solution to help it build and run applications both on-premises and in the cloud.  
  
Which solution should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Anthos provides a platform for building, deploying, and managing applications across on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments with consistent operations. The other services provide cloud-hosted compute capabilities, not hybrid-cloud application management.\
\
**Learn more:** [5 frequently asked questions about Google Cloud Anthos](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/hybrid-cloud/5-frequently-asked-questions-about-google-cloud-anthos)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A manager wants to review employee access to Google Cloud data.  
  
Who is responsible for defining data-access policies?
questions.explanation:
An organization’s IT or IAM administrators define and manage the access policies that control which employees can access its Google Cloud resources and data. Google Cloud provides the identity and access-control services, while the customer organization remains responsible for controlling its personnel’s access.\

**Learn more:** [Authorization and access control](https://cloud.google.com/docs/get-started/authorization-access-control) · [Supporting compliance by restricting customer personnel data access](https://cloud.google.com/assured-workloads/docs/restrict-customer-personnel-access)

questions.explanation: A microservices architecture separates an application into independently deployable services, allowing components to be scaled independently and resources to be used more efficiently.

questions.question: When customer data is uploaded to Google Cloud, who retains ownership of that data?

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: What does logging mean in the context of cloud technology?

options.text: Writing application and operating system events as text
Tracking source code across an organization

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:

What could have prompted this business decision?

options.text: Their on-premises applications only autoscale to meet demand.

Their source code changes erroneously without developer interaction.
Their on-premises applications take months to update and deploy.

Modernizing applications improves agility and deployment speed, enabling teams to release updates more frequently. On-premises applications that take months to update and deploy limit the organization’s ability to respond to changing customer needs.\

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: What is a defining capability of streaming analytics?

Streaming analytics continuously processes incoming data records from an ongoing event stream, supporting real-time analysis and actions. Microsoft Learn describes streaming inputs as unbounded sequences of events that Stream Analytics consumes and processes in real time.\

**Learn more:** [Understand inputs for Azure Stream Analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/stream-analytics/stream-analytics-add-inputs)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization wants to use all available data to provide predictive suggestions on its website that get better over time.  
  
Which method should the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Machine learning uses data to learn predictive patterns and generate personalized recommendations. As additional user history and feedback are collected, the models can be retrained or updated to improve recommendation quality over time.\

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: What is an advantage of Google’s purpose-built servers over standard servers?

They are backward compatible with legacy disk drives.
They are cheaper to build than standard servers.
They run software that cannot be deployed on standard servers.

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence

Why should the organization use application programming interfaces (APIs)?

To operate on a pay-as-you go model so IT can scale flexibly

APIs expose selected capabilities through defined interfaces, allowing legacy systems to integrate with new applications and services while insulating consumers from internal implementation details. questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud

Select a private cloud provider that globally replicates data storage for fast data access
Select a public cloud provider that guarantees data location in the required geographic area
Select a private cloud provider that is only active in the required geographic area

questions.explanation:
Data residency requires an explicit commitment that data at rest remains in the mandated geographic area. A public cloud provider that guarantees the required data location can meet that compliance constraint while its global network and services support worldwide delivery. Microsoft documents that regional services can be deployed to a chosen region and generally keep data within the specified geography.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations

Cloud Monitoring collects and analyzes application and infrastructure metrics and lets users visualize them in dashboards. It is the Google Cloud service designed for monitoring cloud resources and applications.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud Monitoring documentation](https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/docs)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
As your organization raises its release velocity, upgrades to the VM-based application take a long time to complete rolling updates because of OS boot times. You need to speed up application deployments.  
  
What should your organization do?

Increase the resources of your VMs

questions.question: An organization uses Compute Engine and wants to receive sustained-use discounts. What must the organization do?

Commit to virtual machine usage for a one or three-year period.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence

Which Google Cloud product or service should the organization use?

Cloud Natural Language API includes pre-trained content-classification capabilities that analyze text and return applicable categories, making it appropriate for categorizing customer reviews.\

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations

Your organization must build streaming data pipelines. You do not want to manage the individual servers that process data in those pipelines. Instead, you need a managed service that automatically scales with the volume of data being processed.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or feature should the organization select?

Google Cloud Dataflow is a managed service for executing streaming data-processing pipelines. Its horizontal autoscaling adds or removes worker instances as workload and resource utilization change, removing the need to manage the individual processing servers.\

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations

Cloud Monitoring provides centralized visibility into the performance, availability, and health of cloud infrastructure. It includes dashboards, metrics, alerting, and uptime checks for monitoring the availability of internet-accessible services and resources.\

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud

questions.explanation:
Organizations should create and maintain an incident response plan to reduce the impact of a breach. questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities in its cloud infrastructure and applications. Which Google Cloud service should it use?

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization is worried about the unlikely possibility that a person with malicious intent physically accesses Google Cloud infrastructure. How is data safeguarded in Google Cloud?

options.text: Data is immediately deleted whenever an intrusion is detected.
Data is stored on quantum computers with unbreakable encryption.
Data is stored using robust encryption.

\
**Learn more:** [Default encryption at rest](https://docs.cloud.google.com/docs/security/encryption/default-encryption) · [Google security overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/docs/security/overview/whitepaper)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: What is an organization solely responsible for when it accesses an application through a software as a service (SaaS) model?

questions.question: Which Google Cloud product can report on and maintain compliance across your entire Google Cloud organization, including multiple projects?

questions.question: Which Google Cloud product or feature provides specific recommendations based on security risks and compliance violations?

Security Command Center detects vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, evaluates compliance controls, and produces findings with recommendations to address the vulnerability and bring the relevant control into compliance.\

Create a Cloud VPN tunnel between Google Cloud and your data center

options.text: Google Kubernetes Engine with Cloud Bigtable

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization has moved all workloads to the cloud and is reviewing its cloud security posture. Who is now responsible for securing the physical infrastructure in the data centers?

options.text: The organization and the cloud service provider

questions.explanation:
Under the cloud shared-responsibility model, the cloud service provider is responsible for security of the cloud, including the underlying infrastructure and physical security of the facilities where services operate. The customer remains responsible for security in the cloud, such as its data, applications, identities, and configurations.\
\
**Learn more:** [AWS Shared Responsibility Model](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization runs an ecommerce application that needs a cost-effective transactional database. The application will serve customers only within a single region. Which service should it use?
questions.explanation:
Cloud SQL is a fully managed relational database service for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server, making it appropriate for transactional ecommerce data. It is the lowest-cost relational database option, while Cloud Spanner is intended for globally distributed, highly scalable workloads.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cloud SQL for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server](https://cloud.google.com/sql?hl=en) · [Cloud SQL overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/sql/docs/introduction)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization requires protection from distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. Which Google Cloud service should it use?
questions.explanation:
Google Cloud Armor protects applications and infrastructure from distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, including Layer 3/4 volumetric attacks and Layer 7 attacks.\
\
**Learn more:** [Google Cloud Armor documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/armor/docs)

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization must quickly scale its use of computing resources while meeting its environmental-sustainability commitment.  
  
What should the organization do?

options.text: Refactor application software to use less energy.
Use a public cloud provider with energy-efficient data centers.
Use a carbon-neutral energy provider for an existing on-premises data center.
Purchase energy-efficient servers for an existing on-premises data center.

questions.explanation: A public cloud provider can rapidly scale computing capacity on demand, and energy-efficient data centers reduce the environmental impact of that computing use.

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: An organization is developing advanced machine learning models in Google Cloud with TensorFlow. It wants to build its models more quickly by using purpose-built hardware. Which solution should the organization use?

Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are Google-developed, application-specific accelerators designed to speed up machine learning workloads. They efficiently perform the matrix operations common in model training and are supported for TensorFlow workloads.\

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: Your organization wants to ensure that its cloud-service expenditures align with the budget. Which two Google Cloud cost-management features help the organization gain greater visibility into its cloud resource costs? **(Choose two.)**

Cloud Billing dashboards expose cost, usage, and spending-trend information for analysis. questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: An organization requires a flexible, scalable NoSQL database with strong support for web and mobile applications. Which Google Cloud product or service should it use?

Firestore is a flexible, scalable NoSQL document database for mobile, web, and server development, with capabilities such as real-time synchronization and offline support for web and mobile clients.\

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:

options.text: They can avoid the limitations of serverless computing.

questions.explanation: Cloud technology gives developers access to new services and tools that support innovation, while elastic provisioning and managed resources can improve resource utilization and operational efficiency.

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization’s developers are becoming increasingly frustrated with the constraints of their on-premises infrastructure.  
  
How could they benefit from using cloud technology?

options.text: Increase top-down visibility and foster a culture of blamelessness
Shift from an operational expenditure model to capital expenditure
Drive cloud adoption with an individual contributor focus
Invest in on-premises infrastructure to redesign relationships between IT and employees

questions.explanation:
Transformational cloud leadership requires active, visible executive sponsorship and top-down direction, while a blameless culture promotes open communication, learning from mistakes, and continuous improvement. These practices help mobilize people across the organization for outcome-focused, cross-functional change.

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A multinational organization has chosen to use public cloud services to modernize its IT infrastructure.  
  
What is one benefit of this approach?

options.text: They can perform hardware maintenance outside of normal business hours.
They can expect 100% service availability in all regions.
Built-in security is no longer required during data migrations.
Access to data and computer resources is not tied to a geographical location.

questions.explanation:
Public cloud services make data and computing resources accessible over the network, so use of those resources is not inherently limited to one geographic location. Hardware maintenance remains the provider’s responsibility, service availability is not guaranteed at 100% in every region, and data migrations still require security controls.\
\
**Learn more:** [Describe the benefits of using cloud services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/describe-benefits-use-cloud-services/)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
A multinational organization has chosen to use public cloud services to modernize its IT infrastructure.  
  
What is one benefit of this approach?
questions.explanation:
Database Migration Service supports homogeneous MySQL-to-Cloud SQL migrations. Its continuous migration process takes an initial snapshot and replicates ongoing changes until cutover, minimizing downtime; it also supports secure connectivity options, including SSL/TLS, for data in transit.

questions.question: How does Cloud SQL enable organizations to create business insights?

Transforms business data from unstructured to structured

Cloud SQL integrates with business-intelligence and analytics services, including Looker and BigQuery, so those platforms can query, explore, visualize, and analyze data stored in Cloud SQL.\

Any system capable of a task that normally requires human cognition

questions.question:

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization has moved several large databases to the cloud. It wants to increase the value of its data, improve cost controls, and strengthen regulatory compliance. What should the organization do?

options.text: Delete data stored for over a year.
Export relational data to modern NoSQL databases.
Create monthly reports on data access and uses.
Establish an effective data governance program.

An effective data governance program defines data ownership, standards, access and usage controls, quality practices, and lifecycle policies. It enables reliable and valuable data use while reducing duplication and operational costs and enforcing regulatory requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Data Governance?](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/data-governance/) · [Data governance — AWS Cloud Adoption Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-caf-governance-perspective/data-governance.html)

questions.question: What does the move toward cloud computing signify for an organization’s transformation?

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question:
An organization depends on online seasonal sales for most of its yearly revenue.  
  
Why should the organization use App Engine for its customer app?

options.text: Automatically adjusts physical inventory in real time
Recommends the right products to customers

App Engine autoscales application instances in response to incoming load, so the customer app can handle the sharp traffic increases that occur during seasonal sales.\

The resource hierarchy places folders above projects; projects do not contain folders. Cloud Identity domains are associated with organization resources rather than being used to model departmental or environment partitions. [About resource hierarchy | Resource Manager | Google Cloud Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/docs/cloud-platform-resource-hierarchy)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:

Why should it use App Engine?

Because the updated app will only include new features
To run different versions of the app for different users
To run different versions of the app for the same user

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence

questions.domain: Digital Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question:

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization has a large VMware environment that it wants to migrate to the cloud. It wants to retain its existing operational processes and tools. Which Google Cloud service should the organization use?

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: How would a global organization benefit by managing its data with Cloud Spanner?

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question:
An organization has developed an application that can diagnose various medical conditions when users submit images of the affected parts of their bodies.  
  
Which Google Cloud product or service did the organization use?
questions.explanation:
Machine learning supports training and serving image-classification models that analyze submitted images and generate predictions, such as a predicted medical condition. Google Cloud Vertex AI provides image-dataset classification model training, whereas logging, profiling, and application hosting do not perform the diagnostic image inference.\
\
**Learn more:** [Train an image classification model | Vertex AI](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/image-data/classification/train-model) · [Vertex AI documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs)

questions.domain: Modernize Infrastructure and Applications with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization wants to rent the resources required for its customized servers from a cloud provider on a pay-as-you-go basis instead of making a one-time hardware purchase.  
  
Which service model should it use?
questions.explanation: Infrastructure as a service (IaaS) provides on-demand, pay-as-you-go access to underlying computing infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking, while the customer retains control over the server configuration and workloads.

questions.domain: Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
questions.question: What would offer near-unlimited availability of computing resources without requiring your organization to purchase and provision new equipment?
questions.explanation: A public cloud provides on-demand, elastic computing resources from a cloud provider, allowing organizations to scale capacity without procuring and operating new physical equipment.

questions.domain: Exploring Data Transformation with Google Cloud
questions.question: An organization needs to analyze data to gain insights into its day-to-day operations. It wants to pay only for the data it stores and the queries it runs. Which Google Cloud product should the organization select for its data analytics warehouse?
questions.explanation:
BigQuery is a fully managed, serverless data warehouse designed for analytical workloads. It supports pricing for data storage and query processing, including an on-demand model that charges for the data processed by queries.\
\
**Learn more:** [BigQuery pricing](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/pricing) · [BigQuery overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/introduction?hl=en)

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization experiences a major data leak just six months after upgrading its security system.  
  
What should the organization do to ensure security over the long term?

options.text: Extend data retention policy lengths to at least seven years.
Pay more to get the best security system available on the market.
Hire cybersecurity experts to further develop their data security plan
Wait for a more advanced security system to be released

questions.explanation: Long-term data security depends on an actively maintained and continually improved security plan. Cybersecurity experts can assess risks, develop appropriate controls, monitor threats, and adapt the plan as systems and attack methods change.

questions.domain: Trust and Security with Google Cloud
questions.question:
An organization experiences a major data leak just six months after upgrading its security system.  
  
What should the organization do to ensure security over the long term?

options.text: Comply with data security and privacy regulations in each geographical region
Comply with regional standards for data security and privacy, because they supersede all international regulations
Comply with international standards for data security and privacy, because they supersede all regional regulations
Comply with regional data security regulations, because they're more complex than privacy standards

questions.explanation:
Organizations must identify and meet the security, privacy, and data-residency requirements that apply in every relevant jurisdiction. Regulatory obligations depend on the organization’s and customers’ physical locations, along with industry requirements; global standards do not replace applicable regional laws. Google Cloud’s Well-Architected Framework states that these location-specific laws and regulations affect the controls required for workloads.

**Learn more:** [Meet regulatory, compliance, and privacy needs](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/framework/security/meet-regulatory-compliance-and-privacy-needs) · [Google Cloud Compliance Resource Center](https://cloud.google.com/compliance)

questions.domain: Innovating with Google Cloud Artificial Intelligence
questions.question: Which Google Cloud service or feature enables you to build machine learning models with Standard SQL and data in a data warehouse?
questions.explanation:
BigQuery ML lets users build and operationalize machine-learning models over data in BigQuery by using SQL, so it supports model development without moving warehouse data to a separate ML environment.\
\
**Learn more:** [BigQuery ML model creation](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/model-overview)
